defs.def: to do what you are told or expected to do 服从；遵守；顺从

ex.s: her effort to remind mom to obey traffic rules
ex.t: C．她努力提醒妈妈遵守交通规则。

ex.s: When I woke up the next day, there were still rules to obey and lessons to attend.
ex.t: 第二天我醒来时，仍然有规矩要遵守、有课要上。

ex.s: All controls will respond to voice commands, so if you want to change your routine, you just say aloud what you want and the home system will obey.
ex.t: 所有控件都将响应语音命令，因此，如果您想更改例行程序，只需大声说出您想要的内容，家庭系统就会服从。

ex.s: Sometimes it can be kind of tense, and some people don't like to obey the rules or be told what to do.
ex.t: 有时候可能会有点紧张，有些人不喜欢遵守规则或被告诉该做什么。

ex.s: Like bees, every RoboBee has a job to do/obeys a queen bee.
ex.t: 像蜜蜂一样，每只机器蜜蜂都有工作要做/服从蜂王的指挥。

ex.s: LAW 1 LAW 2 LAW 3 A ROBOT MUST OBEY THE ORDERS GIVEN IT BY HUMAN BEINGS EXCEPT WHERE SUCH ORDERS WOULD CONFLICT WITH THE FIRST LAW.
ex.t: 法则1 法则2 法则3 机器人必须遵守人类下达的命令，除非这些命令与第一法则相冲突。
